# attestation-challenge

<!-- Generated by tools/config-reference.py from libs/client-attestation/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/attestation-challenge.json. Do not edit: change the catalogue, then run python3 tools/config-reference.py. -->

The settings of the `attestation-challenge` component of `libs/client-attestation`, read by package `com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.clientattestation.servlet`: generated from its catalogue, [attestation-challenge.json](../../libs/client-attestation/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/attestation-challenge.json), by `tools/config-reference.py`, and checked in CI. [How to read a row](README.md#reading-a-row).

Under the production profile a violation by one of these settings refuses `ATTESTATION_AUTH`, `ATTESTATION_ISSUER` ([components](../development/settings-catalogue.md#components)).

| Setting | Default | What it does | When it's wrong | Profile | Security |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `challengeCacheMaxEntries` (init-param) | `8192`; a whole number, at least -1 | How many unredeemed challenges the endpoint keeps in memory, -1 for no limit; each challenge endpoint reads its own - the authorization server's ClientAttestationChallengeServlet and the attester's AttestationIssuanceChallengeServlet - and neither reaches the other's; with Redis it is not used; without Redis (OIDF_REDIS_URL, in platform-redis) the challenges are in this node's memory, which the production profile allows only with the in-memory-state risk accepted (OIDF_ACCEPTED_RISKS) and otherwise refuses the endpoint's component - ATTESTATION_AUTH for the authorization server's, ATTESTATION_ISSUER for the attester's | **Doesn't start**: Not a whole number from -1 to 2147483647, or 0 in memory: the endpoint's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the setting, and the endpoint answers 503 temporarily_unavailable; its challenges keep the settings they had. Before 0.6.0 a value that was not a whole number was ignored with a warning | Any | Yes |
| `challengeTtlSeconds` (init-param) | `300`; seconds, at least 1 | How long a challenge the endpoint issues can be redeemed, in seconds, in memory and in Redis alike; each challenge endpoint reads its own - the authorization server's ClientAttestationChallengeServlet and the attester's AttestationIssuanceChallengeServlet - and neither reaches the other's | **Doesn't start**: Not a whole number of seconds from 1: the endpoint's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the setting, and the endpoint answers 503 temporarily_unavailable; its challenges keep the settings they had. Before 0.6.0 a value that was not a whole number was ignored with a warning | Any | Yes |
| `challengeRateLimitPerWindow` (init-param) | `60`; a whole number | How many challenges one caller (by remote address) may have from the endpoint in a window; over it, 429 slow_down with Retry-After; each challenge endpoint reads its own - the authorization server's ClientAttestationChallengeServlet and the attester's AttestationIssuanceChallengeServlet - and neither reaches the other's | **Doesn't start**: Not a whole number: the endpoint's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the setting, and the endpoint answers 503 temporarily_unavailable (before 0.6.0 it was ignored with a warning). 0 or less: the default | Any | Yes |
| `challengeRateLimitWindowSeconds` (init-param) | `60`; seconds | The endpoint's rate-limit window, in seconds; each challenge endpoint reads its own - the authorization server's ClientAttestationChallengeServlet and the attester's AttestationIssuanceChallengeServlet - and neither reaches the other's | **Doesn't start**: Not a whole number: the endpoint's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the setting, and the endpoint answers 503 temporarily_unavailable (before 0.6.0 it was ignored with a warning). 0 or less: the default | Any | Yes |
| `challengeRateLimitMaxCallers` (init-param) | `16384`; a whole number | How many callers the endpoint's rate limit counts at once, the oldest forgotten first; each challenge endpoint reads its own - the authorization server's ClientAttestationChallengeServlet and the attester's AttestationIssuanceChallengeServlet - and neither reaches the other's | **Doesn't start**: Not a whole number: the endpoint's part is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the setting, and the endpoint answers 503 temporarily_unavailable (before 0.6.0 it was ignored with a warning). 0 or less: the default | Any | Yes |
| `replayCacheMaxEntries` (init-param) | `8192`; a whole number, at least -1 | How many PoP and DPoP jtis the authorization server's in-memory replay cache keeps, -1 for no limit; read on ClientAttestationChallengeServlet only, at deploy, and not used with Redis; without Redis (OIDF_REDIS_URL, in platform-redis) the replay cache is in this node's memory, which the production profile allows only with the in-memory-state risk accepted (OIDF_ACCEPTED_RISKS) and otherwise refuses ATTESTATION_AUTH | **Doesn't start**: Not a whole number from -1 to 2147483647, or 0 in memory: the authorization server's challenge endpoint is FAILED_CONFIG at deploy, naming the setting, and the replay cache keeps the size it had. Before 0.6.0 a value that was not a whole number was ignored with a warning | Any | Yes |
